title: Parametric Knowledge is Not All You Need: Toward Honest Large Language Models via Retrieval of Pretraining Data
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical definition of 'LLM honesty' as a model's ability to recognize the boundaries of its factual knowledge and refrain from hallucinating by responding 'I don't know.' It uses factual datasets like TriviaQA to benchmark this capability and does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical reasoning.
